verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an in-product AI insights analytics view. It shows what visitors ask and how well the Assistant answers from your content. Separately, the GitBook Agent identifies missing or outdated content and drafts improvements, so the product itself generates both insights and suggestions from your docs and usage data. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what the insights contain and how suggestions are surfaced, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI insights shows what your visitors are asking and how effectively GitBook Assistant responds using your content.
GitBook’s AI documentation agent identifies missing or outdated content, drafts improvements, and helps your team keep product knowledge aligned with real user needs
The docs platform that flags outdated content. Then fixes it.
